newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Q2 growth data confirm recovery - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Q2 growth data confirm recovery - Rato.

text.p: Spain's second quarter GDP growth of 1.9 percent year-on-year shows the economy is recovering, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Wednesday.

"(The GDP data published earlier) back up government and outside analysis that since the beginning of the year there has been an economic recovery that has settled in Spain," Rato told journalists after a closed door meeting in parliament on the budget. "It (the growth) coincides with what is happening in the rest of the European Union," he added.
The minister said the figures also "seemed to back" a recovery in private consumption and in capital goods investment.
